scope_limitations: This verifies transport bytes and chosen accession coverage. It does not adjudicate corporate control,censoring or subject/filer identity.
Accession tables inventory non-HTML graphics and complete submission text,which remain separately unreviewed.
Legacy EFTS transport identity and original world coverage remain unverified.
Captured bytes are current SEC HTTP responses. SEC delivery markup can change response length from the filing index. Exact response hashes do not establish byte identity with the filing as accepted.
